This system generates and protects repository “RIPSTOP” guardrails artifacts for AI-assisted coding workflows. It produces a tool-tailored RIPSTOP.md document from a resolved configuration and emits Claude Code deny-permission settings that discourage automated weakening of guardrails. The primary users are repository maintainers and CI or release scripts that regenerate artifacts. It interacts with Claude Code’s settings merge behavior, various AI tool formats, and the repository filesystem where guardrails and settings are stored.

```mermaid
C4Context
title Ripstop Guardrails Artifact Generator - C4 Context

Person(repoMaintainer, "Repository Maintainer", "Configures guardrails and regenerates outputs")
Person(ciPipeline, "CI/Release Pipeline", "Automates generation and verification of artifacts")

System_Boundary(ripstopBoundary, "Ripstop Guardrails Artifact Generator") {
  System(ripstopGen, "Ripstop Generator", "Generates RIPSTOP.md and Claude deny-settings JSON from resolved config")
}

System_Ext(repoFs, "Repository Filesystem", "Stores .guardrails/, RIPSTOP.md, and .claude/settings files")
System_Ext(configSchema, "Ripstop Config Schema", "IRipstopConfig and resolved checks/bypass settings")
System_Ext(claudeCode, "Claude Code", "Reads merged .claude/settings.json and enforces permissions.deny")
System_Ext(aiTools, "AI Coding Tools", "Claude/Cursor/Codex/Amazon Q consume tool-specific guardrails text")

Rel(repoMaintainer, ripstopGen, "Runs to generate guardrails artifacts")
Rel(ciPipeline, ripstopGen, "Runs in automation to regenerate/validate outputs")

Rel(ripstopGen, configSchema, "Consumes", "TypeScript types/config contract")
Rel(ripstopGen, repoFs, "Writes", "RIPSTOP.md; .claude/settings.ripstop.json")
Rel(claudeCode, repoFs, "Reads and merges", ".claude/settings.json + .claude/settings.ripstop.json")
Rel(claudeCode, ripstopGen, "Is targeted by", "deny rules protecting guardrails/settings")
Rel(aiTools, repoFs, "Read", "RIPSTOP.md (format-specific variants)")
```

Key components and interactions center on two outputs. The generator writes RIPSTOP.md to the repository filesystem, embedding generation metadata and a SHA-256 configuration hash that downstream checks can extract and compare for freshness. It also writes a Claude Code settings fragment (.claude/settings.ripstop.json) containing permissions.deny rules that block edits/writes to guardrails-critical paths (the primary guardrails file, .guardrails/, RIPSTOP.md, and Claude settings). Claude Code then merges this fragment into its effective settings and enforces the deny list. AI tools consume RIPSTOP.md variants (Claude wrapper, Cursor headings, Codex/Amazon Q prefixes).
